events.title: Demo Update — Nights, Vows & Abyss Fragments
events.summary: Hello! In our August 11 announcement, we talked about more to do at night, a rework of weekly events, and making the next journey worth approaching differently. With Steam Next Fest ahead, this demo update brings those plans into the game. Here is how they have taken shape. More Choices After Dark We have removed the default restriction on acting at night and added nighttime actions at certain gathering sites. events.title: Steam Page Now Live – Free Demo Coming in August 2026
events.summary: Solo Developer: untitled01The Steam page for Fire Vow: Dark Fantasy, a card-based dark fantasy survival game where you must endure the final 15 days of a once-radiant world, is now live.The free demo is scheduled for release in August 2026. The exact release date will be announced once it has been confirmed.We would greatly appreciate it if you added the game to your wishlist.
